description.para: Offsets of registers from the start of the device.
The WDT registers start at an offset 0x20.
The bits of this register control the prescaler, WD/Timer mode, interrupt enable, auto-reload, and watchdog enable.
This register indicates the Counter register has reached zero in Counter mode.
This register indicates the Counter register has reached zero in Watchdog mode and a reset request is sent.
Writes to this register switch from watchdog mode to timer mode.
The software must write 0x12345678 and 0x87654321 successively to the Watchdog Disable Register so that the watchdog mode bit in the Watchdog Control Register is set to zero.

detaileddescription.para: The XScuWdt_ConfigTable[] contains the configuration info for each device in the system.

simplesect.para: A pointer to the configuration found, or NULL if the specified device ID or base address was not found. See xscuwdt.h for the definition of XScuWdt_Config.
In the XSCT/classic flow, the driver uses DeviceId to look up the device configuration.

briefdescription.para: Runs a self-test on the WDT.

detaileddescription.para: This test stops the watchdog and writes a value to the watchdog load register. It then starts the watchdog and verifies the value read from the counter register is less than the value written to the load register. It then restores the control register and the watchdog load register.

listitem.para: XST_FAILURE if the WDT is not decrementing.

briefdescription.para: Checks if the watchdog has timed out and caused the last reset.

detaileddescription.para: This macro reads the watchdog load register and writes the same value to the load register to update the counter register. An application must call this function periodically to keep the watchdog from asserting the WDRESETREQ reset request output pin.

briefdescription.para: Writes to the watchdog timer load register.

detaileddescription.para: This also updates the watchdog counter register with the new value. Use this macro to change the time-out value.
